summary: Overdue hiker found deceased on a snow slope ~1,000 feet below the Challenger/Kit Carson saddle
notes: Cause of death not stated; body recovery Run 307: Center Post-Dispatch identifies the subject as Tyler Cline, 27, of Buena Vista; he left Sunday to climb Kit Carson Peak and was reported missing when he missed work; car found at the Kit Carson trailhead Wednesday. Run 375: snowbrains account merged (same incident: solo hiker attempting all Colorado 14ers, body found between Kit Carson Peak and Challenger Point).
